subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary The passage deals with the problem of land and food safety of Bangladesh. We all know that our country is very small. But the population is increasing day by day while the land is decreasing. So we are losing our cultivable lands and for this reason our food production is decreasing seriously. So to solve this problem, we can introduce modern scientific farming and we can reclaim land in the Bay of Bengal.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : 131 which was 35%. In 2011, 58% people used mobile phone. Again in 2012, the number of mobile phone users increased which was 75% in Bangladesh. The numbers of mobile phone users among the Bangladeshis were on the increase which stood 88% in 2013. Thus from this bar chart we see that every year the users of mobile phone gradually were on the increase in Bangladesh. On the whole, the bar chart focuses on the numbers of mobile phone users in Bangladesh from 2009 to 2013.
